faqs.q: What are the cashback benefits of Swiggy BLCK HDFC Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card offers 10% cashback on Swiggy spends, 5% cashback on select online merchants like Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, and 1% cashback on other eligible spends. Besides this, it also offers additional discount on Nykaa and Cleartrip in addition to the accelerated cashback.

faqs.q: Does Swiggy BLCK HDFC Credit Card offer any discounts on travel or shopping?
faqs.a: Yes, it offers up to 19% discount on Cleartrip hotel bookings, 6% on travel bookings via Cleartrip, and 5% discount on Nykaa purchases. In addition to this, it also offers additional birthday discount on Swiggy Dineout.

faqs.q: Are there any lifestyle benefits with this card?
faqs.a: Yes, it offers 12 free golf lessons, and 4 complimentary green fees annually under the Mastercard Golf Program, plus a 50% discount on additional green fees.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Swiggy Ornge and Swiggy BLCK Credit Card?
faqs.a: Swiggy BLCK is the premium variant of Swiggy Ornge Card. Both offer accelerated cashback on Swiggy and online spends at partner merchants, but BLCK offers higher cashback of 10% on Swiggy spends, while Ornge offers 5%. Additionally, BLCK comes with a complimentary BLCK membership for 3 months, whereas Ornge offers a Swiggy One membership for 1 year. Both cards also offer a base cashback of 1% and complimentary golf benefits under the Mastercard Golf Program.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for Swiggy BLCK HDFC Credit Card?
faqs.a: Salaried applicants must be 21 to 60 years old with a minimum monthly income of Rs. 1 Lakh. Self-employed applicants must be 21 to 65 years old with an annual ITR above Rs. 12 Lakh.

faqs.q: Is this card good for online shopping apart from Swiggy?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers 5% cashback on partner merchants like Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Cleartrip, and BookMyShow, making it ideal for online shopping in addition to Swiggy orders.

faqs.q: What are the fees and charges of this credit card?
faqs.a: The card has a joining fee and annual fee of Rs. 1,000. However, it offers joining fee waiver on spending Rs. 75,000 within the first 90 days and annual fee waiver on spending Rs. 2 Lakh in a year.

faqs.question: Is the Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining fee and annual fee are ₹1000 + GST each. The joining fee is waived if you spend ₹75,000 in the first 90 days, and the annual fee is waived when you spend ₹2 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: How much cashback does Swiggy BLCK give on Swiggy?
faqs.answer: You get 10% cashback on Swiggy Food, Instamart and Dineout on orders of ₹249 or more, up to ₹1500 per billing cycle.

faqs.question: Does the Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No. The card does not come with any domestic or international lounge access.
